# storybook-vrhythm

> Baseline grid overlay for Storybook 10. Draws a customizable vertical rhythm grid on stories to visually verify spacing and alignment during development. Zero runtime dependencies. Framework agnostic.

## Overview

`storybook-vrhythm` is a Storybook addon that injects a CSS `linear-gradient`-based overlay into stories. It helps developers verify that components align to a baseline grid without leaving Storybook. The overlay is non-interactive (`pointer-events: none`) and toggleable via the toolbar.

Supported frameworks: React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Web Components, HTML.

## Installation

```bash
npm install --save-dev storybook-vrhythm
# pnpm add -D storybook-vrhythm
# yarn add -D storybook-vrhythm
```

Requirements: Node.js 20+, Storybook 10+.

## Setup

### Option A: Addon preset (recommended)

Add to `.storybook/main.ts`:

```typescript
export default {
  addons: ['storybook-vrhythm'],
};
```

This automatically registers the decorator and toolbar toggle for all stories.

### Option B: Manual decorator

```typescript
// .storybook/preview.ts
import { withVRhythm } from 'storybook-vrhythm';

export const decorators = [withVRhythm];
```

## Configuration

Parameters are passed via `parameters.vrhythm` at the story or global level.

### Global defaults (.storybook/preview.ts)

```typescript
export const parameters = {
  vrhythm: {
    lineHeight: '8px',
    color: 'rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.2)',
  },
};
```

### Per-story

```typescript
export const MyStory = {
  parameters: {
    vrhythm: {
      preset: 'material',
    },
  },
};

export const Hidden = {
  parameters: {
    vrhythm: { hide: true },
  },
};
```

## Style Parameters

| Parameter     | Type               | Default                | Description                                        |
| ------------- | ------------------ | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `color`       | `string`           | `'rgb(204, 204, 204)'` | CSS color for horizontal guide lines               |
| `lineHeight`  | `string \| number` | `'16px'`               | Baseline grid height (e.g. `'8px'`, `'1rem'`)      |
| `lineWidth`   | `string \| number` | `'1px'`                | Thickness of each horizontal guide line            |
| `offset`      | `string \| number` | `0`                    | Vertical offset from the top of the container      |
| `opacity`     | `number`           | `1`                    | Overlay opacity (0–1)                              |
| `zIndex`      | `number`           | `9999`                 | Stack order of the overlay                         |
| `maxWidth`    | `string \| number` | —                      | Centers the overlay horizontally at this max width |
| `columnWidth` | `string \| number` | —                      | Repeating column width for vertical column grid    |
| `columnColor` | `string`           | —                      | Color for column lines (falls back to `color`)     |
| `gutterWidth` | `string \| number` | —                      | Gutter between columns (requires `columnWidth`)    |

## Config Parameters

| Parameter   | Type      | Default | Description                                                        |
| ----------- | --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `hide`      | `boolean` | `false` | Hide the overlay for this story (overrides toolbar toggle)         |
| `preset`    | `string`  | —       | Built-in preset name                                               |
| `container` | `string`  | —       | CSS selector for the overlay parent element (defaults to `body`)   |

## Built-in Presets

Pass `preset` in `parameters.vrhythm` to use a ready-made configuration.

| Preset name | lineHeight | color                       | Use case                  |
| ----------- | ---------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| `4px`       | 4px        | `rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.15)`  | Dense UIs, compact grids  |
| `8px`       | 8px        | `rgba(0, 150, 255, 0.2)`   | Standard 8pt grid         |
| `16px`      | 16px       | `rgba(204, 204, 204, 0.5)` | Body text baseline        |
| `24px`      | 24px       | `rgba(204, 204, 204, 0.5)` | Heading alignment         |
| `material`  | 4px        | `rgba(244, 67, 54, 0.15)`  | Material Design           |
| `tailwind`  | 4px        | `rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15)` | Tailwind CSS              |
| `bootstrap` | 8px        | `rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.2)`  | Bootstrap                 |

## Exports

```typescript
import { withVRhythm, presets } from 'storybook-vrhythm';
import type { VRhythmParams, StyleProps, ConfigProps, PresetName } from 'storybook-vrhythm';
```

- `withVRhythm` — Storybook `DecoratorFunction` that injects the overlay
- `presets` — record of all built-in preset configurations
- `VRhythmParams` — `StyleProps & ConfigProps` (all parameters combined)
- `StyleProps` — visual style parameters
- `ConfigProps` — behavior parameters (`hide`, `preset`, `container`)
- `PresetName` — union type of valid preset names (`'4px' | '8px' | '16px' | '24px' | 'material' | 'tailwind' | 'bootstrap'`)

## Toolbar Globals

The addon registers a `vrhythm` global with these toolbar values:

| Value        | Behavior                                      |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| `'true'`     | Use story-level parameters (default)          |
| `'false'`    | Hide the overlay                              |
| `'4px'`      | Override with 4px preset                     |
| `'8px'`      | Override with 8px preset                     |
| `'16px'`     | Override with 16px preset                    |
| `'24px'`     | Override with 24px preset                    |
| `'material'` | Override with Material Design preset          |
| `'tailwind'` | Override with Tailwind CSS preset             |
| `'bootstrap'`| Override with Bootstrap preset                |

Story-level `hide: true` always overrides the toolbar toggle.

## How it works

1. A `<div id="storybook-rhythm">` is injected into the DOM (or reused if already present)
2. Its `background` is set to a `linear-gradient` that repeats at `lineHeight` intervals
3. If `columnWidth` is set, a second `linear-gradient(90deg, ...)` layer creates vertical columns
4. The div is positioned `absolute` with `pointer-events: none` so it never interferes with stories
5. On hide, the div is removed from the DOM entirely

## TypeScript

The package ships a Storybook parameter augmentation that adds `vrchythm` to `Parameters` and `Globals` automatically when imported via the preset or `preview` entry point.

```typescript
// These types are inferred automatically — no manual augmentation needed
export const MyStory: StoryObj = {
  parameters: {
    vrhythm: { preset: 'tailwind' }, // fully typed
  },
};
```
